public_scope: two induced-minimal seven-vertex obstructions to the gem/house/HVN sufficiency rule for orthogonal-tree representability; full Question 15 remains open

source.paper: Maria Axenovich, Dingyuan Liu, and Arsenii Sagdeev, Ramsey problems for graphs in Euclidean spaces and Cartesian powers
source.locator: Appendix B.2, Orthogonal trees, Question 15, physical PDF page 27

claim: The seven-vertex graphs H_adj=F@UeW and H_dis=F@UuO avoid the gem, house, and HVN induced obstructions, are not orthogonal-tree representable, and are induced-minimal with that property.
definitions: orthogonal-tree representability as equality at value 1 in a positive weighted tree metric
exact even leaf powers for graphs with at least two vertices
gem, house, and HVN five-vertex induced obstructions
induced-minimal nonrepresentable graph outside the three old obstructions

verification.covered_scope: the exact strict partial result curated here
